name: Instrument/utility air compressors, receivers and dryers
description: Instrument/utility air packages comprise rotary-screw, oil-free screw or reciprocating compressors, knock-out drum, filters, refrigerated or adsorption dryers, receiver tanks, piping, instrumentation and valves. Instrument air must be dry and oil-free and is typically distributed at 6 bar (100 psig).
aliases: Instrument/utility air compressors, receivers and dryers

specifications.metric: Instrument air package - compressor, KO  — Instrument air mains pressure
specifications.basis: Air normally distributed at a mains pressure of 6 bar (100 psig)

specifications.metric: Price — Cost of drying air for instrument air
specifications.basis: Drying the air, for example for instrument air, typically adds about $0.005 per standard m 3 ($0.14/1000 scf) - Chemical Engineering Design 2nd ed., ©2013, no separate dollar year stated; dollar year 2013.
